name: food-rescue
description: Food Rescue — connects surplus food with verified NGOs and volunteers. Advanced SQL course project (MySQL 8).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix server
